content: {"episode_id":"ep-05054","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring) for episode ep-05054, submitted with diagnosis codes R55 and I47.1. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope associated with palpitations, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia. Per that note, given the intermittent nature of these symptoms and the need for continuous rhythm correlation during daily activities, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring was ordered to capture potential arrhythmic events. As invited in SilverBridge's letter, this documentation is submitted as the supporting clinical justification of medical necessity for the service."}
